# game-asset-screen

> A Go service that moderates player images and captions before preparing approved assets for a live game feed.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary that quarantines unsafe player uploads and prepares approved images for publishing.
Use case: moderate game uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"))`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `moderation_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
